title: Add analytics dashboard with revenue trends, service categories, and top performers charts

requirements.text: Add a revenue trends over time line chart to the AnalyticsPage showing daily or weekly revenue progression

quotes: 3 charts showing revenue trends, service categories, and top performers

acceptanceCriteria: Line chart displays revenue data over a time period (e.g., last 30 days)
Chart uses the existing gradient theme colors (teal green primary, electric blue accent)
Chart animates on initial load
Chart is wrapped in a ChartBlock component with appropriate title

requirements.text: Add a service categories distribution chart to the AnalyticsPage showing breakdown of services by category or niche

quotes: 3 charts showing revenue trends, service categories, and top performers

acceptanceCriteria: Pie chart or bar chart shows services grouped by niche or category
Chart displays count or revenue per category
Chart uses gradient theme colors consistently
Chart animates on load and updates
Chart is wrapped in a ChartBlock component

requirements.text: Add a top performers chart to the AnalyticsPage ranking services or leads by revenue or conversion metrics

quotes: 3 charts showing revenue trends, service categories, and top performers

acceptanceCriteria: Bar chart or ranking list shows top 5-10 performers
Chart displays either top services by revenue or top-converting leads
Chart uses gradient theme styling
Chart animates on load
Chart is wrapped in a ChartBlock component with descriptive title

requirements.text: Integrate a React charting library (Recharts or similar) that supports line charts, pie charts, and bar charts with animation capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Charting library is installed and configured
Library supports responsive charts
Library works with existing React Query data flows
Charts render without layout issues on mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Compute revenue trends data from existing analytics hook (useAgencyAnalytics) by aggregating payment or project data over time periods
acceptanceCriteria: Revenue data is computed from existing payments or projects data
Data is grouped by time period (daily, weekly, or monthly)
Computation handles empty or missing data gracefully
Data structure matches chart component requirements

requirements.text: Update AnalyticsPage layout to display the three new charts in a responsive grid below existing metrics cards
acceptanceCriteria: Charts are arranged in a clean grid layout
Layout is responsive on mobile and desktop
Charts maintain gradient theme styling
Existing metrics cards remain visible above charts
Loading and error states are handled for all charts

constraints: Do not modify backend/main.mo or add new backend endpoints
Use existing useAgencyAnalytics hook data without changing its API
Maintain gradient theme (teal green #00b3a4, electric blue #00f0ff, deep matte black #0f0f0f)
Preserve existing AnalyticsPage metrics cards and layout structure
Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Adding new backend analytics endpoints or data models
Implementing real-time chart updates or WebSocket connections
Adding export functionality for chart data
Creating custom chart components from scratch
Modifying the service catalog or adding new analytics metrics beyond the three requested charts
